description: The author's curated reading orders through the dictionary: one per topic (how ChatGPT works, AI foundations, explainable and trustworthy AI, mathematics of AI, ...), each with its audience and its terms in the order to read them. Takes no arguments. Use when someone asks what to learn, read, or teach about a topic, or how to structure a course or seminar, so the answer follows the author's order instead of an improvised one.
name: list_learning_paths
